database.query: SELECT mspt.id AS id, mspt.reg_date AS reg_date, area.name AS area_name, obsv.name AS point_name, COALESCE((SELECT r.n FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.n) AS base_n, COALESCE((SELECT r.e FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.e) AS base_e, COALESCE((SELECT r.z FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.z) AS base_z, mspt.h_ang AS h_ang, mspt.v_ang AS v_ang, mspt.sd AS sd, mspt.n - COALESCE((SELECT r.n FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.n) + obsv.n AS n, mspt.e - COALESCE((SELECT r.e FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.e) + obsv.e AS e, mspt.z - COALESCE((SELECT r.z FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.z) + obsv.z AS z, (mspt.n - COALESCE((SELECT r.n FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.n)) * 1000 AS d_n, (mspt.e - COALESCE((SELECT r.e FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.e)) * 1000 AS d_e, (mspt.z - COALESCE((SELECT r.z FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.z)) * 1000 AS d_z, (SQRT(POW(mspt.n - COALESCE((SELECT r.n FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.n), 2) + POW(mspt.e - COALESCE((SELECT r.e FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.e), 2) + POW(mspt.z - COALESCE((SELECT r.z FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.z), 2))) * 1000 AS variation_3d FROM tmos_total_station_measure_pt mspt LEFT JOIN tmos_total_station_observ_pt obsv ON mspt.obsv_id = obsv.id LEFT JOIN tmos_total_station_area area ON mspt.area_id = area.id LEFT JOIN tmos_total_station_job job ON area.job_id = job.id LEFT JOIN tmos_total_station_outlier_opt outlier_opt ON area.id = outlier_opt.area_id WHERE mspt.removed = 0 AND obsv.id IS NOT NULL AND mspt.id > %s AND (outlier_opt.id IS NULL OR (ABS((mspt.n - COALESCE((SELECT r.n FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.n)) * 1000) < outlier_opt.n * 1000 OR ABS((mspt.e - COALESCE((SELECT r.e FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.e)) * 1000) < outlier_opt.e * 1000 OR ABS((mspt.z - COALESCE((SELECT r.z FROM tmos_total_station_observ_pt_ref r WHERE r.obsv_id = mspt.obsv_id AND r.reg_date < mspt.reg_date ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC LIMIT 1), obsv.z)) * 1000) < outlier_opt.z * 1000)) ORDER BY mspt.id ASC LIMIT 1000
